messages.subject: Re: Gift return request
messages.text:
Hello Elaine,
 

 Here are the steps for a return/exchange:
 

 1. Visit https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and postal code, you need to select the products you want to return, and then choose the replacements. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, package the products to be returned, and adhere the label to the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags instead of boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, we will send the new product(s). 😊
 

 Warm regards,
 

 __
 Laurence 
 

 Lasclay
